hook: Ah yes. The first-workout soreness.
caption:
Ah yes. The first-workout soreness.
 
When sitting on the toilet becomes a trust fall and stairs are suddenly your worst enemy. 😂
 
Here’s something I wish more people understood about fitness: being sore isn’t the same thing as making progress.
 
Yes, some soreness is normal when you’re starting out, trying something new, or returning after time away.
 
But the goal isn’t to see how much discomfort you can tolerate for the next three days.

title: Ten minutes at the end of a session, done properly, is plenty.
hook: Ten minutes at the end of a session, done properly, is plenty.
caption:
Ten minutes at the end of a session, done properly, is plenty.

4 finishers under 10 minutes:
1. Battle-rope intervals: 20 seconds on, 40 off, 6 rounds
2. Kettlebell swing EMOM: 10 swings every minute for 6 minutes
3. Farmer’s carry: heavy pair, 30-40 metres, 4 rounds
4. Bike or rower sprints: 15 seconds hard, 45 easy, 6-8 rounds

Pick one, not all four. Save this for your next session.

title: Nobody got fit in a week. Nobody lost it in a week either.

One missed session, one big dinner, one bad night of sleep. It doesn't undo anything. 🤍
